title: Send the subsidiary NetSuite OneWorld requires on every sales order
reason: In a NetSuite OneWorld account every transaction belongs to a subsidiary, and NetSuite refuses a sales order without one (USER_ERROR "Please enter value(s) for: Subsidiary"). The adopted adapter sends entity, date, reference, memo and items, and has no way to send a subsidiary: every order is refused once the account is OneWorld.
originalBehavior: PUT /record/v1/salesOrder/eid:… with entity, tranDate, otherRefNum, memo, item.items — no subsidiary
replacementBehavior: the same body plus subsidiary: { id } when the adapter is given subsidiaryId (the customer's choice, from the integration configuration); without the option the request is byte-for-byte the original
providerEvidence: NetSuite USER_ERROR "Please enter value(s) for: Subsidiary" observed on the customer's own refused orders
assumptions: One subsidiary for all orders of this store (the customer's decision); per-order subsidiaries are not supported.
The subsidiary is active and accepts the order's customer and items (checked in validation and verified after).
validation: every held order produces a request whose body equals the unpatched body plus exactly the chosen subsidiary
with no subsidiary configured the patched adapter sends the original request
the chosen subsidiary is an active NetSuite subsidiary
the previous artifact still loads (rollback target)
rollback: Roll back the correction: the original adapter runs again; orders already created keep their subsidiary.
